@@p01 trigger copy NEW to record, return it
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN r := NEW; r.fe := 'x'; RETURN r; END $$
@@p02 trigger return populated record
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN jsonb_populate_record(NEW, '{"fe":"x"}'); END $$
@@p03 trigger rowtype var
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE r aveloxis_data.repos%ROWTYPE; BEGIN r := NEW; r.fe := 'x'; RETURN r; END $$
@@p04 trigger CALL with INOUT NEW.fe
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN CALL setit(NEW.fe); RETURN NEW; END $$
@@p05 built-in trigger fn writes column
CREATE TRIGGER tg BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON aveloxis_data.repos FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION tsvector_update_trigger(fe, 'pg_catalog.english', x)
@@p06 trigger alias for NEW
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE n ALIAS FOR NEW; BEGIN n.fe := 'x'; RETURN n; END $$
@@p07 trigger NEW.fe := 
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.fe := 'x'; RETURN NEW; END $$
@@p08 trigger RETURNS pg_catalog.trigger
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS pg_catalog.trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.fe := 'x'; RETURN NEW; END $$
@@p09 trigger RETURNS "trigger" upper lang
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS "trigger" LANGUAGE PLPGSQL AS $$ BEGIN NEW.fe := 'x'; RETURN NEW; END $$
@@p10 trigger FETCH INTO NEW.fe
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT 'x'; BEGIN OPEN c; FETCH c INTO NEW.fe; RETURN NEW; END $$
@@p11 trigger EXECUTE INTO NEW.fe
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN EXECUTE 'SELECT 1' INTO NEW.fe; RETURN NEW; END $$
@@p12 trigger GET DIAGNOSTICS NEW.fe
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN GET DIAGNOSTICS NEW.fe = ROW_COUNT; RETURN NEW; END $$
@@p13 trigger FOR NEW.fe IN
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN FOR NEW.fe IN SELECT 'x' LOOP NULL; END LOOP; RETURN NEW; END $$
@@p14 trigger FOREACH NEW.fe
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN FOREACH NEW.fe IN ARRAY ARRAY['x'] LOOP NULL; END LOOP; RETURN NEW; END $$
@@p15 trigger UPDATE RETURNING INTO NEW.fe
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE s.o SET a = 1 RETURNING a INTO NEW.fe; RETURN NEW; END $$
@@p16 trigger nested block NEW
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN BEGIN NEW.fe := 'x'; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NEW.fe := 'y'; END; RETURN NEW; END $$
@@p17 trigger integer for loop var NEW.fe
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN FOR NEW.fe IN 1..3 LOOP NULL; END LOOP; RETURN NEW; END $$
@@p18 trigger assign to OLD then return OLD
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN OLD.fe := 'x'; RETURN OLD; END $$
@@p19 trigger subscript on NEW col
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.fe[1] := 'x'; RETURN NEW; END $$
@@p20 trigger select into strict two targets
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE a int; BEGIN SELECT 1, 'x' INTO STRICT a, NEW.fe; RETURN NEW; END $$
@@p21 plpgsql plain update
DO $$ BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x'; END $$
@@p22 plpgsql execute literal
DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE 'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = ''x'''; END $$
@@p23 plpgsql execute E-literal
DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE E'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = \'x\''; END $$
@@p24 plpgsql execute dollar literal
DO $a$ BEGIN EXECUTE $b$UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x'$b$; END $a$
@@p25 plpgsql execute literal using
DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE 'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1' USING 'x'; END $$
@@p26 plpgsql execute format
DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE format('UPDATE %I.%I SET fe = %L', 'aveloxis_data', 'repos', 'x'); END $$
@@p27 plpgsql execute concat
DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE 'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos' || ' SET fe = 1'; END $$
@@p28 plpgsql execute variable
DO $$ DECLARE q text := 'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 1'; BEGIN EXECUTE q; END $$
@@p29 plpgsql execute literal cast
DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE 'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 1'::text; END $$
@@p30 plpgsql execute parenthesised literal
DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE ('UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 1'); END $$
@@p31 plpgsql return query update
CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS SETOF int LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN QUERY UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x' RETURNING id; END $$
@@p32 plpgsql return query execute literal
CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS SETOF int LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN QUERY EXECUTE 'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = ''x'' RETURNING id'; END $$
@@p33 plpgsql open for with cte update
DO $$ DECLARE c refcursor; BEGIN OPEN c FOR WITH u AS (UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x' RETURNING 1) SELECT * FROM u; END $$
@@p34 plpgsql bound cursor decl with update cte
DO $$ DECLARE c CURSOR FOR WITH u AS (UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x' RETURNING 1) SELECT * FROM u; BEGIN OPEN c; END $$
@@p35 plpgsql for cursor loop
DO $$ DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT 1; r record; BEGIN FOR r IN c LOOP UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x' WHERE CURRENT OF c; END LOOP; END $$
@@p36 plpgsql case stmt arm
DO $$ BEGIN CASE WHEN TRUE THEN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x'; ELSE NULL; END CASE; END $$
@@p37 plpgsql while/loop/exit
DO $$ BEGIN LOOP WHILE TRUE LOOP UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x'; END LOOP; EXIT; END LOOP; END $$
@@p38 plpgsql labelled nested block
DO $$ <<a>> BEGIN <<b>> DECLARE x int; BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x'; END b; END a $$
@@p39 plpgsql if else
DO $$ BEGIN IF TRUE THEN NULL; ELSE UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x'; END IF; END $$
@@p40 plpgsql foreach body
DO $$ DECLARE x int; BEGIN FOREACH x IN ARRAY ARRAY[1] LOOP UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x'; END LOOP; END $$
@@p41 plpgsql insert on conflict
DO $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (id) VALUES (1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET fe = 'x'; END $$
@@p42 plpgsql merge
DO $$ BEGIN MERGE INTO aveloxis_data.repos t USING s.stg s ON t.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET fe = 'x'; END $$
@@p43 plpgsql into strict update
DO $$ DECLARE n int; BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x' RETURNING id INTO STRICT n; END $$
@@p44 plpgsql perform with fn only (control: should PASS, no write)
DO $$ BEGIN PERFORM 1; END $$
@@p45 plpgsql update with rowtype var value
DO $$ DECLARE r aveloxis_data.repos%ROWTYPE; BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = r.x; END $$
@@p46 plpgsql update set row = record
DO $$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET (fe, x) = (SELECT r.a, r.b); END $$
@@p47 procedure with commit
CREATE PROCEDURE p() LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x'; COMMIT; END $$
@@p48 do without language keyword but LANGUAGE sql? (invalid)
DO LANGUAGE sql $$ UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x' $$
@@p49 function old style quoted body sql
CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS void AS 'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = ''x''' LANGUAGE sql
@@p50 function begin atomic
CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql BEGIN ATOMIC UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x'; END
@@p51 function begin atomic no language
CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS void BEGIN ATOMIC SELECT 1; UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x'; END
@@p52 procedure begin atomic
CREATE PROCEDURE p() BEGIN ATOMIC UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x'; END
@@p53 function RETURN (subquery with cte?) 
CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS int LANGUAGE sql RETURN (WITH u AS (UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x' RETURNING 1) SELECT 1)
@@p54 function no language as string
CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS void AS 'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 1'
@@p55 function language "SQL" quoted upper
CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS void LANGUAGE "SQL" AS 'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 1'
@@p56 function language 'sql' string
CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS void LANGUAGE 'sql' AS 'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 1'
@@p57 function language c
CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS void LANGUAGE c AS 'obj', 'sym'
@@p58 function language internal
CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS void LANGUAGE internal AS 'pg_sleep'
@@p59 function two languages last wins
CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql LANGUAGE plpgsql AS 'BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 1; END'
@@p60 function two languages plpgsql then sql
CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql LANGUAGE sql AS 'BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 1; END'
@@p61 function two AS
CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql AS 'SELECT 1' AS 'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 1'
@@p62 function two AS reversed
CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql AS 'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 1' AS 'SELECT 1'
@@p63 DO two bodies
DO 'BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 1; END' LANGUAGE plpgsql
@@p64 function in create schema
CREATE SCHEMA s CREATE TABLE t (a int) CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT fe AS z FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@@p65 alter function (no body) control PASS
ALTER FUNCTION f() SECURITY DEFINER
@@p66 plpgsql sql function inside execute inside sql fn
CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql AS $$ DO $x$ BEGIN EXECUTE 'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 1'; END $x$ $$
@@w01 view schema-qualified renamed col
CREATE VIEW s.v AS SELECT id, fe AS z FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@;
UPDATE s.v SET z = 'x'
@@w02 view unqualified renamed col
CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT id, fe AS z FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@;
UPDATE v SET z = 'x'
@@w03 temp view renamed col
CREATE TEMP VIEW v AS SELECT id, fe AS z FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@;
UPDATE pg_temp.v SET z = 'x'
@@w04 view over view
CREATE VIEW s.v1 AS SELECT id, fe AS z FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@;
CREATE VIEW s.v2 AS SELECT id, z AS y FROM s.v1
@;
UPDATE s.v2 SET y = 'x'
@@w05 view over unqualified source
CREATE VIEW s.v AS SELECT id, fe AS z FROM repos
@;
UPDATE s.v SET z = 'x'
@@w06 view made in DO/EXECUTE
DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE 'CREATE VIEW s.v AS SELECT id, fe AS z FROM aveloxis_data.repos'; END $$
@;
UPDATE s.v SET z = 'x'
@@w07 view column list rename
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW s.v (a, z) AS SELECT id, fe FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@;
UPDATE s.v SET z = 'x'
@@w08 security barrier view
CREATE VIEW s.v WITH (security_barrier) AS SELECT id, fe AS z FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@;
UPDATE s.v SET z = 'x'
@@w09 view made in create schema element
CREATE SCHEMA s CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT id, fe AS z FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@;
UPDATE s.v SET z = 'x'
@@w10 view TABLE form
CREATE VIEW s.v AS TABLE aveloxis_data.repos
@;
UPDATE s.v SET fe = 'x'
@@w11 view in same text, multiple statements
CREATE VIEW s.v AS SELECT id, fe AS z FROM aveloxis_data.repos; UPDATE s.v SET z = 'x'
@@w12 view insert on conflict through view
CREATE VIEW s.v AS SELECT id, fe AS z FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@;
INSERT INTO s.v (id) VALUES (1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET z = 'x'
@@w13 view merge through view
CREATE VIEW s.v AS SELECT id, fe AS z FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@;
MERGE INTO s.v t USING s.stg s ON t.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET z = 'x'
@@w14 view renamed then written
CREATE VIEW s.v AS SELECT id, fe AS z FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@;
ALTER VIEW s.v RENAME TO v9
@;
UPDATE s.v9 SET z = 'x'
@@w15 view with instead-of rule (create rule _RETURN)
CREATE TABLE s.v (id int, z text)
@;
CREATE RULE "_RETURN" AS ON SELECT TO s.v DO INSTEAD SELECT id, fe AS z FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@;
UPDATE s.v SET z = 'x'
@@w16 view via ONLY source / lateral
CREATE VIEW s.v AS SELECT r.id, r.fe AS z FROM ONLY aveloxis_data.repos r
@;
UPDATE s.v SET z = 'x'
@@w17 foreign table loopback
CREATE FOREIGN TABLE s.ft (id int, z text OPTIONS (column_name 'fe')) SERVER loopback OPTIONS (schema_name 'aveloxis_data', table_name 'repos')
@;
UPDATE s.ft SET z = 'x'
@@w18 view quoted schema case
CREATE VIEW "S".v AS SELECT id, fe AS z FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@;
UPDATE "S".v SET z = 'x'
@@w19 view created in function body sql
CREATE FUNCTION mk() RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql AS 'CREATE VIEW s.v AS SELECT id, fe AS z FROM aveloxis_data.repos'
@;
UPDATE s.v SET z = 'x'
@@w20 view with source in db-qualified form
CREATE VIEW s.v AS SELECT id, fe AS z FROM mydb.aveloxis_data.repos
@;
UPDATE s.v SET z = 'x'
@@x01 temp table shadow via search_path (not registered table; control)
CREATE TEMP TABLE repos (LIKE aveloxis_data.repos); UPDATE pg_temp.repos SET fe = 'x'
@@x02 look-alike cyrillic e in column (different column; control PASS)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fе = 'x'
@@x03 update indirection target field
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe.sub = 'x'
@@x04 update subscript target with conforming-looking value
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe[1] = COALESCE(fe, $1)
@@x05 qualified target (table.col) set
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET repos.fe = 'x'
@@x06 select fn (control PASS)
SELECT evil()
@@x07 CALL (control PASS)
CALL evil()
@@x08 insert select from update cte returning
WITH u AS (INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (id) SELECT 1 ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET fe = 'x' RETURNING *) SELECT * FROM u
@@x09 update with returning trick
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET x = 1, fe = 'x' RETURNING fe AS "COALESCE(fe, $1)"
@@x10 update where current of
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE CURRENT OF c
@@x11 two statements second bad
SELECT 1; UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x'
@@x12 fe set from subquery row
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = (SELECT $1)
@@x13 fe guarded bare but value literal
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = 'x' WHERE fe IS NULL
@@x14 fe guarded by NULL test with excluded.fe in plain update
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1::text WHERE fe IS NULL
@@x15 fe conflict guard on alias-less table name with alias present
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos AS t (id) VALUES ($1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET fe = $2 WHERE repos.fe IS NULL
@@x16 fe guard alias equals other from-table name
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 FROM s.repos WHERE repos.fe IS NULL
@@x17 fe guard coalesce nulltest argisrow
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE (fe) IS NULL AND TRUE
@@x18 fe guard IS UNKNOWN
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE (fe IS NULL) IS UNKNOWN
@@x19 fe guard coalesce with collate
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE COALESCE(fe, '') = '' COLLATE "C" OR TRUE
@@x20 fe guard ANDed inside OR-paren
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE (fe IS NULL AND id = 1) OR id = 2
@@x21 fe guard double negation
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE NOT NOT fe IS NULL
@@x22 fe guard IS NULL on expression w/ col
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE (fe || 'x') IS NULL
@@x23 fe guard in conflict-update but plain cte
WITH g AS (SELECT 1 WHERE fe IS NULL) UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1
@@x24 pnn excluded with catalog qualification
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (id) VALUES ($1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET pnn = COALESCE(a.excluded.pnn, repos.pnn)
@@x25 pn nullif excluded other column then stored
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (id) VALUES ($1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET pn = COALESCE(NULLIF(excluded.other, ''), repos.pn)
@@x26 pn stored is excluded-like table alias
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET pn = COALESCE(NULLIF($1, ''), "excluded".pn) FROM s.stg AS excluded
